title: SRTN（抢占式最短剩余时间）：逐时刻抢占决策
expected_output:
进程(A=到达, S=服务): P1(A=0,S=8), P2(A=1,S=4), P3(A=2,S=9), P4(A=3,S=5)

--- 抢占时间线（每一格谁在跑）---
  t=0 切换到 P1
  t=1 切换到 P2
  t=5 切换到 P4
  t=10 切换到 P1
  t=17 切换到 P3

完成时间:
  P1: 完成=17, 周转=17, 带权周转=2.12
  P2: 完成= 5, 周转= 4, 带权周转=1.00
  P3: 完成=26, 周转=24, 带权周转=2.67
  P4: 完成=10, 周转= 7, 带权周转=1.40

平均周转时间 = 13.00
特点: 抢占式，每次有新进程到达都重新比较剩余时间 -> 平均周转最小（抢占情形下最优）
code:
def srtn(procs):
    """procs: [(pid, arrive, service)] 抢占式：每次有新进程到达或进程完成时重新决策"""
    remaining = {p[0]: p[2] for p in procs}
    arrive = {p[0]: p[1] for p in procs}
    n = len(procs)
    now = 0
    finished = {}
    gantt = []
    done = set()
    events = []
    while len(done) < n:
        # 候选：已到达且未完成
        cand = [(remaining[p], p) for p in remaining
                if p not in done and arrive[p] <= now]
        if not cand:
            now += 1
            continue
        cand.sort()
        rem, pid = cand[0]
        nxt = now + 1
        gantt.append((now, nxt, pid))
        remaining[pid] -= 1
        if remaining[pid] == 0:
            done.add(pid)
            finished[pid] = nxt
            events.append("t=%d %s 完成" % (nxt, pid))
        now = nxt
    return gantt, finished


procs = [("P1", 0, 8), ("P2", 1, 4), ("P3", 2, 9), ("P4", 3, 5)]
gantt, fin = srtn(procs)

print("进程(A=到达, S=服务): " + ", ".join("%s(A=%d,S=%d)" % (p[0], p[1], p[2]) for p in procs))
print("")
print("--- 抢占时间线（每一格谁在跑）---")
cur = None
for s, f, pid in gantt:
    if cur != pid:
        print("  t=%d 切换到 %s" % (s, pid))
        cur = pid
print("")
print("完成时间:")
for pid in sorted(fin):
    a = [p[1] for p in procs if p[0] == pid][0]
    sv = [p[2] for p in procs if p[0] == pid][0]
    t = fin[pid] - a
    print("  %s: 完成=%2d, 周转=%2d, 带权周转=%.2f" % (pid, fin[pid], t, t / sv))
avg = sum(fin[p] - [q[1] for q in procs if q[0] == p][0] for p in fin) / len(fin)
print("")
print("平均周转时间 = %.2f" % avg)
print("特点: 抢占式，每次有新进程到达都重新比较剩余时间 -> 平均周转最小（抢占情形下最优）")
